def source_projection(snapshot):
    """Bind raw source offsets and visible words to exact ChatMarkdown rendering."""
    answer = snapshot["replies"][-1]["payload"]["text"]
    frames = snapshot["probe"]["frames"]
    arrivals, _ = assert_arrival_receipts(snapshot)
    item_id = snapshot["replies"][-1]["payload"]["itemId"]
    deltas = [a["text"] for a in arrivals if a["itemId"] == item_id]
    assert answer and js_utf16_length(answer) <= 8000, \
        "motion answer exceeds the bounded projection fixture budget"
    texts = [frame["text"] for frame in frames]
    plain = not re.search(r"[\n\r`*_~|#<>\[\]\\!]", answer) and \
        all(answer.startswith(text) for text in texts) and \
        snapshot["probe"]["finalText"] == answer
    if plain:
        cumulative, previous, projected = "", "", []
        for delta in deltas:
            cumulative += delta
            assert answer.startswith(cumulative), "arrival is not a saved source prefix"
            projected.append({"sourceUtf16": js_utf16_length(cumulative),
                              "visibleChanged": cumulative != previous,
                              "contentChanged": cumulative != previous,
                              "requiredMinSourceUtf16": js_utf16_length(cumulative),
                              "projectedUtf16": js_utf16_length(cumulative),
                              "projectedWords": len(cumulative.split())})
            previous = cumulative
        result = {"version": 1, "terminal": answer, "terminalVisible": answer,
                  "terminalContent": answer,
                  "frames": [{"minSourceUtf16": js_utf16_length(text),
                              "maxSourceUtf16": js_utf16_length(text),
                              "visible": text, "content": text,
                              "visibleWords": len(text.split()),
                              "contentWords": len(text.split())} for text in texts],
                  "arrivals": projected, "sourceUtf16": js_utf16_length(answer),
                  "identity": {"mode": "plain-source-byte-exact"}}
    else:
        result = run_markdown_projection(answer, frames, deltas)
        frontend = Path(required("AFT_TESTS_DIR")).resolve().parents[1] / "internal/webui/frontend"
        identity = result.get("identity")
        assert isinstance(identity, dict) and \
            identity.get("chatMarkdownSha256") == hashlib.sha256((
                frontend / "src/components/AgentChat/ChatMarkdown.tsx").read_bytes()).hexdigest() and \
            identity.get("longTextSha256") == hashlib.sha256((
                frontend / "src/components/AgentChat/LongText.tsx").read_bytes()).hexdigest() and \
            identity.get("codeHighlightSha256") == hashlib.sha256((
                frontend / "src/components/AgentChat/codeHighlight.ts").read_bytes()).hexdigest() and \
            identity.get("messageCopySha256") == hashlib.sha256((
                frontend / "src/components/AgentChat/MessageCopyButton.tsx").read_bytes()).hexdigest() and \
            identity.get("cssSha256") == hashlib.sha256((
                frontend / "src/components/AgentChat/ChatMarkdown.module.css").read_bytes()).hexdigest() and \
            identity.get("lockSha256") == hashlib.sha256((
                frontend / "package-lock.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest() and \
            isinstance(identity.get("dependencies"), dict) and \
            all(identity["dependencies"].get(name) for name in (
                "react", "react-dom", "react-markdown", "remark-gfm",
                "rehype-sanitize", "esbuild", "jsdom")), \
            "ChatMarkdown source or installed dependency identity changed"
    assert result.get("version") == 1 and result.get("sourceUtf16") == js_utf16_length(answer) and \
        len(result.get("frames", [])) == len(frames) and \
        len(result.get("arrivals", [])) == len(deltas) and \
        all(type(frame.get("streaming")) is bool and isinstance(row, dict) and
            isinstance(row.get("minSourceUtf16"), int) and
            isinstance(row.get("maxSourceUtf16"), int) and
            isinstance(row.get("visible"), str) and
            type(row.get("visibleWords")) is int and
            isinstance(row.get("content"), str) and
            type(row.get("contentWords")) is int and
            0 <= row["minSourceUtf16"] <= row["maxSourceUtf16"] <= js_utf16_length(answer)
            for frame, row in zip(frames, result["frames"])) and \
        all(isinstance(frame.get("visibleText"), str) and isinstance(frame.get("contentText"), str) and
            frame["visibleText"].split() == row["visible"].split() and
            frame["contentText"].split() == row["content"].split() and
            frame.get("words") == row["contentWords"] == len(row["content"].split()) and
            row["visibleWords"] == len(row["visible"].split())
            for frame, row in zip(frames, result["frames"])) and \
        all(isinstance(row, dict) and type(row.get("visibleChanged")) is bool and
            type(row.get("contentChanged")) is bool and
            isinstance(row.get("sourceUtf16"), int) and
            isinstance(row.get("requiredMinSourceUtf16"), int) and
            isinstance(row.get("projectedWords"), int) and
            0 <= row["requiredMinSourceUtf16"] <= row["sourceUtf16"] <= js_utf16_length(answer)
            for row in result["arrivals"]), \
        "rendered frame has no exact source-backed ChatMarkdown projection"
    positions = [row["minSourceUtf16"] for row in result["frames"]]
    assert positions == sorted(positions), \
        "rendered Markdown source projection moved backward during the live turn"
    assert result["terminal"] == snapshot["probe"]["finalText"], \
        "final rendered ChatMarkdown text differs from the exact saved answer projection"
    assert isinstance(snapshot["probe"].get("finalVisibleText"), str) and \
        result["terminalVisible"].split() == snapshot["probe"]["finalVisibleText"].split(), \
        "final visible ChatMarkdown words differ from the exact saved source projection"
    assert isinstance(snapshot["probe"].get("finalContentText"), str) and \
        result["terminalContent"].split() == snapshot["probe"]["finalContentText"].split(), \
        "final reply content differs from the exact saved source projection"
    return result

def assert_frame_pacing(snapshot, projection=None):
    probe = snapshot["probe"]
    frames = probe["frames"]
    arrivals, completions = assert_arrival_receipts(snapshot)
    ticks = assert_clock_ledger(snapshot)
    reply = snapshot["replies"][-1]
    item_id = reply["payload"]["itemId"]
    item_arrivals = [a for a in arrivals if a["itemId"] == item_id]
    assert item_arrivals, "visible assistant item has no real delta arrival"
    final_completion = next(c for c in completions if c["eventId"] == reply["event_id"])
    projection = projection or source_projection(snapshot)
    exceptions = []
    previous_words = 0
    first_live_reply_seen = False
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        text = frame.get("text")
        visible_text = frame.get("visibleText")
        content_text = frame.get("contentText")
        assert isinstance(text, str) and isinstance(visible_text, str) and isinstance(content_text, str) and \
            frame.get("chars") == js_utf16_length(text) and \
            frame.get("visibleChars") == js_utf16_length(visible_text) and \
            frame.get("contentChars") == js_utf16_length(content_text) and \
            frame.get("words") == len(content_text.split()) and frame.get("addedWords") == \
            max(0, frame["words"] - previous_words), \
            f"rendered frame bytes, words, or cadence changed at frame {index}"
        previous_words = frame["words"]
        count = frame["addedWords"]
        if frame.get("streaming") is True and frame["words"] > 0 and not first_live_reply_seen:
            first_live_reply_seen = True
            assert count <= 2, \
                "first live reply-content frame exceeded two words without a catch-up exception"
        if count <= 2:
            continue
        if index == len(frames) - 1 and frame.get("streaming") is False and \
           frame.get("marker") and \
           text == probe["finalText"] and final_completion["phase"] < frame["phase"] and \
           final_completion["mono"] <= frame["mono"] and \
           frame["mono"] - final_completion["mono"] <= 300:
            exceptions.append({"kind": "saved-completion-flush", "frame": index,
                               "added_words": count, "event_id": reply["event_id"],
                               "completion_lag_ms": frame["at"] - final_completion["at"]})
            continue
        assert index > 0, "first live frame exceeded two words without a catch-up exception"
        earlier = [a for a in item_arrivals if a["phase"] < frame["phase"] and
                   a["mono"] <= frame["mono"]]
        assert earlier, "large frame has no matching real arrival"
        raw_source_utf16 = js_utf16_length("".join(a["text"] for a in earlier))
        assert projection["frames"][index]["minSourceUtf16"] <= raw_source_utf16, \
            "large frame lacks exact source-backed arrival projection"
        previous_visible = frames[index - 1]["words"]
        previous_source = max(
            (row["minSourceUtf16"] for row in projection["frames"][:index]), default=0)
        projected_arrivals = projection["arrivals"][:len(earlier)]
        assert len(projected_arrivals) == len(earlier), \
            "large frame lacks exact source-backed arrival projection"
        recent_ticks = ticks[:frame["tickIndex"] + 1][-12:]
        intervals = [b["mono"] - a["mono"] for a, b in zip(recent_ticks, recent_ticks[1:])
                     if b["mono"] > a["mono"]]
        assert len(intervals) >= 5, "large frame lacks measured refresh cadence"
        min_interval = min(intervals)
        pending = []
        for arrival, row in zip(earlier, projected_arrivals):
            if not row["contentChanged"] or \
               row["requiredMinSourceUtf16"] <= previous_source or \
               row["projectedWords"] <= previous_visible:
                continue
            assert row["requiredMinSourceUtf16"] <= raw_source_utf16, \
                "large frame lacks exact source-backed arrival projection"
            deadline = arrival["mono"] + 300
            assert ticks[-1]["mono"] >= deadline, \
                "large frame lacks a complete measured arrival-deadline horizon"
            future_ticks = [tick for tick in ticks[frame["tickIndex"] + 1:]
                            if tick["mono"] <= deadline]
            required = row["projectedWords"] - previous_visible - 2 * len(future_ticks)
            pending.append((required, arrival, row["projectedWords"], deadline,
                            len(future_ticks)))
        assert pending, "large frame has no unrevealed arrival backlog"
        required_now, pressure, target_words, deadline, future_tick_count = max(
            pending, key=lambda entry: entry[0])
        assert required_now > 2 and count <= required_now, \
            "large frame was unnecessary for the measured arrival backlog and 300ms deadline"
        assert any(f["mono"] <= deadline and f["words"] >= target_words for f in frames[index:]), \
            "large frame did not actually meet the pending arrival deadline"
        exceptions.append({"kind": "measured-backlog-catch-up", "frame": index,
                           "added_words": count, "arrival_at": pressure["at"],
                           "deadline": pressure["at"] + 300,
                           "deadline_mono": deadline,
                           "backlog_words": projected_arrivals[-1]["projectedWords"] - previous_visible,
                           "required_now": required_now, "cadence_ms": min_interval,
                           "future_ticks": future_tick_count})
    return exceptions

def assert_arrival_deadlines(snapshot, projection=None):
    """Every visible source-backed delta prefix must reach the DOM within 300ms."""
    arrivals, _ = assert_arrival_receipts(snapshot)
    reply = snapshot["replies"][-1]
    item_id = reply["payload"]["itemId"]
    frames = snapshot["probe"]["frames"]
    projection = projection or source_projection(snapshot)
    proofs = []
    item_arrivals = [a for a in arrivals if a["itemId"] == item_id]
    for arrival, projected in zip(item_arrivals, projection["arrivals"]):
        if not projected["contentChanged"]:
            proofs.append({"source_id": arrival["sourceId"], "item_id": item_id,
                           "arrival_at": arrival["at"], "source_utf16": projected["sourceUtf16"],
                           "status": "no-new-reply-content"})
            continue
        rendered = next(((frame, mapped) for frame, mapped in zip(frames, projection["frames"])
                         if frame["phase"] > arrival["phase"] and
                         frame["mono"] >= arrival["mono"] and
                         mapped["minSourceUtf16"] >= projected["requiredMinSourceUtf16"]), None)
        assert rendered is not None, \
            "arrival lacks exact source-backed DOM projection; Markdown pacing is unverified"
        deadline = arrival["mono"] + 300
        assert rendered[0]["mono"] <= deadline, \
            "arrival text rendered after its 300ms catch-up deadline"
        proofs.append({"source_id": arrival["sourceId"], "item_id": item_id,
                       "arrival_at": arrival["at"], "deadline": arrival["at"] + 300,
                       "deadline_mono": deadline,
                       "rendered_at": rendered[0]["at"], "lag_ms": rendered[0]["at"] - arrival["at"],
                       "lag_mono_ms": rendered[0]["mono"] - arrival["mono"],
                       "source_utf16": projected["sourceUtf16"],
                       "required_min_source_utf16": projected["requiredMinSourceUtf16"],
                       "rendered_min_source_utf16": rendered[1]["minSourceUtf16"]})
    assert any("rendered_at" in proof for proof in proofs), \
        "no real visible arrival deadline was measurable"
    return proofs

def assert_motion_capture(snapshot):
    probe = snapshot["probe"]
    delivered = snapshot["delivered"]
    end = snapshot["turn_completed"]
    replies = snapshot["replies"]
    answer = snapshot["answer"]
    assert delivered["kind"] == "message.delivered" and f"VISUAL_RENDER_{RUN}" in delivered["payload"]["text"], \
        "frozen motion delivery is not the real rendering request"
    assert end["kind"] == "agent.turn_completed" and end["seq"] > delivered["seq"], \
        "frozen motion turn completion does not follow delivery"
    assert replies and all(e["kind"] == "item.completed" and e["payload"].get("itemKind") == "message" and
                           delivered["seq"] < e["seq"] < end["seq"] for e in replies), \
        "frozen motion reply items are missing or outside the turn"
    assert answer == "\n".join(e["payload"].get("text", "") for e in replies), \
        "frozen motion answer differs from saved assistant items"
    marker = f"VISUAL_END_{RUN}"
    frames = probe["frames"]
    word_count = len(answer.split())
    assert word_count >= 300, f"model supplied only {word_count} words; 300-word motion criterion unverified"
    assert probe["observerError"] is None, probe["observerError"]
    assert probe["sawCaret"] and probe["sawWorking"] and probe["sawStop"], \
        "streaming caret/working row/Stop were not observed"
    assert len(frames) > 3 and len(set(f["chars"] for f in frames)) > 3, "no measured real text progression"
    projection = source_projection(snapshot)
    exceptions = assert_frame_pacing(snapshot, projection)
    deadlines = assert_arrival_deadlines(snapshot, projection)
    terminal_exit = assert_terminal_exit(snapshot)
    assert sum(s["value"] for s in probe["shifts"]) == 0, "non-input layout shift during streaming"
    assert probe["samples"] and all(s["gap"] == 0 for s in probe["samples"] if s["stop"]), "live follow lost the bottom"
    marker_frame = final_text_frame(answer, frames, probe["finalText"], marker)
    # The completed event timestamp is saved by the product. Browser Date.now
    # and serve share this host clock; this proven-final DOM frame is the bound.
    end_at = end.get("created_at")
    assert end_at, "turn completion lacks a saved timestamp"
    from datetime import datetime
    turn_ms = datetime.fromisoformat(end_at.replace("Z", "+00:00")).timestamp() * 1000
    lag_ms = final_text_lag(marker_frame, turn_ms)
    assert probe["caretGone"], "caret or working row remained after turn"
    return marker_frame, turn_ms, lag_ms, exceptions, terminal_exit, deadlines, projection["identity"]

def reasoning_receipts(between):
    saved = [{"event_id": e.get("event_id"), "text": e["payload"].get("text", "")}
             for e in between if e["kind"] == "item.completed" and e["payload"].get("itemKind") == "reasoning"]
    assert saved and all(item["event_id"] and isinstance(item["text"], str) and item["text"].strip()
                         for item in saved), "missing saved reasoning item/content"
    assert len({item["event_id"] for item in saved}) == len(saved), "duplicate reasoning EventID"
    return saved

def assert_reasoning_rows(saved, rows, expanded):
    assert len(rows) == len(saved), "Thinking row count differs from saved reasoning items"
    for item, row in zip(saved, rows):
        assert row["heading"] == "Thinking" and row["status"] == "completed", row
        assert row["preview"] == reasoning_preview(item["text"]) and len(row["preview"]) <= 120, \
            f"Thinking preview differs from saved first line: {item['event_id']}"
        assert row["expanded"] == ("true" if expanded else "false"), row
        assert row["body"] == (item["text"] if expanded else None), \
            f"Thinking full text differs from saved item: {item['event_id']}"

def assert_reasoning_saved_after_reload(before, after):
    assert after == before, "reload changed reasoning EventID, order, or saved content"

def assert_reasoning_captures(before, after):
    for stage, capture in (("before-reload", before), ("reloaded", after)):
        delivered, end, items = capture["delivered"], capture["turn_completed"], capture["items"]
        assert delivered["kind"] == "message.delivered" and \
            f"VISUAL_RENDER_{RUN}" in delivered["payload"]["text"], f"{stage}: foreign rendering delivery"
        assert end["kind"] == "agent.turn_completed" and end["seq"] > delivered["seq"], \
            f"{stage}: turn completion does not follow delivery"
        assert isinstance(items, list), f"{stage}: reasoning items missing"
        assert all(e["kind"] == "item.completed" and e["payload"].get("itemKind") == "reasoning" and
                   delivered["seq"] < e["seq"] < end["seq"] for e in items), \
            f"{stage}: reasoning item outside saved turn"
        seqs = [e["seq"] for e in items]
        assert seqs == sorted(set(seqs)), f"{stage}: duplicate or unordered reasoning sequence"
    assert_reasoning_saved_after_reload(before["delivered"], after["delivered"])
    assert_reasoning_saved_after_reload(before["turn_completed"], after["turn_completed"])
    assert_reasoning_saved_after_reload(before["items"], after["items"])

def handed_delivery(label, stage, call, before):
    body = json.loads(call["body"])
    key = "msg_" + hashlib.sha256((agent_id(label) + "\x00" + call["key"]).encode()).hexdigest()[:26]
    matches = [e for e in before["events"] if e["kind"] == "message.delivered" and
               e["payload"].get("text") == body.get("text") and e["payload"].get("inputKey") == key]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        return False
    try:
        proof, native = load(label, stage + "-delivery"), load(label, stage + "-native-input")
    except (FileNotFoundError, KeyError):
        return False
    return (proof["event_id"] == matches[0]["event_id"] and proof["native_input_key"] == key and
            proof["text"] == body["text"] and native["input_key"] == key and
            native["agent_id"] == agent_id(label) and native["native_user_message_count"] == 1)

def replay(label, calls_stage, state_stage, count):
    """Replay exact UI RequestIDs through the public user route; no new mutation."""
    before = load(label, state_stage)
    # Withdraw is not an idempotent receipt route: replay only Send RequestIDs.
    calls = [c for c in load(label, calls_stage)["ui_calls"] if c["method"] == "POST"][:int(count)]
    assert len(calls) == int(count) and calls, "UI request records absent"
    assert len({c["key"] for c in calls}) == len(calls), "UI reused a RequestID"
    progressed, observed = False, []
    for c in calls:
        assert c["path"] == path(label) + "/messages"
        result = http(c["path"], c["method"], json.loads(c["body"]) if c["body"] else None, c["key"])
        changed = isinstance(result, dict) and isinstance(c["result"], dict) and result.get("state") != c["result"].get("state")
        proof = handed_delivery(label, state_stage, c, before) if changed and result.get("state") == "handed" else False
        if not same_send_result(c["result"], result, proof):
            save(label, state_stage + "-receipt-mismatch", {"request_id": c["key"],
                  "original": public_send_receipt(c["result"]), "retry": public_send_receipt(result)})
        assert same_send_result(c["result"], result, proof), "retry changed stable public receipt fields or lacks exact handover proof"
        progressed |= changed
        observed.append(public_send_receipt(result))
    after = agent(label)
    assert after["waiting_messages"] == before["waiting"], "old RequestID changed waiting slots"
    kinds = {"message.waiting", "message.withdrawn", "message.delivered"} if progressed else {"message.waiting", "message.withdrawn"}
    before_ids = [e["event_id"] for e in before["events"] if e["kind"] in kinds]
    after_ids = [e["event_id"] for e in pages(label) if e["kind"] in kinds]
    assert after_ids == before_ids, "retry appended a waiting or withdrawn event"
    if progressed:
        prior_native = load(label, state_stage + "-native-input")
        native_count(label, state_stage)
        after_native = load(label, state_stage + "-native-input")
        assert (after_native["agent_id"], after_native["input_key"], after_native["native_user_message_count"]) == (
            prior_native["agent_id"], prior_native["input_key"], 1), "retry changed owned native input count"
    save(label, state_stage + "-replay", {"request_ids": [c["key"] for c in calls],
                                          "receipts": [c["result"] for c in calls],
                                          "replayed_receipts": observed, "slot_event_ids": before_ids})

def replay_u3():
    receipt = load("receipt-u3")
    demand(receipt["body"] == {"text": TEXT["u3"], "delivery": "interrupt"} and
           receipt["result"].get("interrupted") is True, "original U3 interrupt receipt invalid")
    before_events = events("child")
    before_agent = agent("child")
    demand(before_agent["state"] == "finished" and not before_agent["waiting_messages"],
           "U3 replay must happen after natural delivery")
    replayed = http(f"{ROOT}/{quote(identity('child'))}/messages", receipt["body"], receipt["request_id"])
    after_events = events("child")
    after_agent = agent("child")
    fields = ("message_id", "state", "replaced", "interrupted", "turn_id")
    def accepted_result(original, retry, handed_proof):
        allowed = set(fields)
        if not isinstance(original, dict) or not isinstance(retry, dict) or set(original) != set(retry) or not set(original) <= allowed:
            return False
        if not {"message_id", "state", "replaced", "interrupted"} <= set(original):
            return False
        if (not isinstance(original["message_id"], str) or not original["message_id"] or
                original["state"] not in ("waiting", "handed") or type(retry["state"]) is not str or
                any(type(value[key]) is not bool for value in (original, retry) for key in ("replaced", "interrupted")) or
                any(type(value["turn_id"]) is not str for value in (original, retry) if "turn_id" in value)):
            return False
        if any(original[key] != retry[key] for key in set(original) - {"state"}):
            return False
        return original["state"] == retry["state"] or (original["state"] == "waiting" and
               retry["state"] == "handed" and handed_proof)

    def handed_proof():
        child = identity("child")
        key = "msg_" + hashlib.sha256((child + "\x00" + receipt["request_id"]).encode()).hexdigest()[:26]
        pair = load("first-delivery")["delivered"]
        native = load("first-native-inputs")
        rows = [e for e in before_events if e.get("agent_id") == child and e["kind"] == "message.delivered" and
                e["payload"].get("text") == TEXT["u3"] and e["payload"].get("inputKey") == key]
        return (len(rows) == 1 and len(pair) == len(native) == 2 and
                pair[0]["event_id"] == rows[0]["event_id"] and pair[0]["input_key"] == key and
                native[0]["agent_id"] == child and native[0]["input_key"] == key and
                native[0]["native_user_message_count"] == 1)

    progressed = isinstance(replayed, dict) and receipt["result"]["state"] == "waiting" and replayed.get("state") == "handed"
    accepted = accepted_result(receipt["result"], replayed, handed_proof() if progressed else False)
    def safe_result(value):
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            return {}
        result = {}
        for key in fields:
            if key in value:
                expected_type = bool if key in ("replaced", "interrupted") else str
                result[key] = value[key] if isinstance(value[key], expected_type) else "<invalid type>"
        return result
    before_ids = [(e["seq"], e["event_id"]) for e in before_events]
    after_ids = [(e["seq"], e["event_id"]) for e in after_events]
    save("u3-replay-diagnostic", {"original_request_id": receipt["request_id"],
                                  "retry_request_id": receipt["request_id"],
                                  "original": safe_result(receipt["result"]), "replay": safe_result(replayed),
                                  "original_fields_present": [key for key in fields if key in receipt["result"]],
                                  "replay_fields_present": [key for key in fields if isinstance(replayed, dict) and key in replayed],
                                  "receipt_equal": replayed == receipt["result"],
                                  "receipt_accepted": accepted,
                                  "events_before": before_ids, "events_after": after_ids,
                                  "events_equal": after_ids == before_ids,
                                  "agent_before": {"state": before_agent["state"], "attempt": before_agent["attempt"],
                                                   "waiting_count": len(before_agent["waiting_messages"])},
                                  "agent_after": {"state": after_agent["state"], "attempt": after_agent["attempt"],
                                                  "waiting_count": len(after_agent["waiting_messages"])},
                                  "slots_equal": after_agent["waiting_messages"] == before_agent["waiting_messages"]})
    demand(accepted, "same U3 RequestID changed stable receipt fields or lacks saved handover proof")
    demand(after_ids == before_ids, "U3 replay added a saved event")
    demand(after_agent["state"] == before_agent["state"] and
           after_agent["attempt"] == before_agent["attempt"] and
           after_agent["waiting_messages"] == before_agent["waiting_messages"],
           "U3 replay mutated the finished child")
    pair = load("first-delivery")["delivered"]
    demand(len(pair) == 2 and all(x["input_key"] for x in pair), "First delivery input keys missing")
    prior_native = load("first-native-inputs")
    native_inputs()
    after_native = load("first-native-inputs")
    demand([(p["agent_id"], p["input_key"], p["native_id"], p["native_root"], p["native_user_message_count"])
            for p in after_native] ==
           [(p["agent_id"], p["input_key"], p["native_id"], p["native_root"], 1) for p in prior_native],
           "U3 replay changed the owned native input count")
    save("u3-replay", {"request_id": receipt["request_id"], "result": replayed,
                       "event_ids_before_after": [e["event_id"] for e in after_events],
                       "input_keys": [x["input_key"] for x in pair]})

cases.name: real repo reply renders markdown tools motion and copy after reload
cases.intent: A real Lead reads the owned repository, attempts a benign missing read, renders grounded table/code and saved tool items, and preserves exact copy and history after reload.
cases.evidence_class_required: real OpenCode and external model; exact native evidence per case; historical result not promoted
cases.actor_policy: Preserve browser person actions, explicit public API client actions, agent-authored tool calls, and runtime stimulus as distinct actors; do not replace one with another.
cases.exact_original_case_source:
- name: real repo reply renders markdown tools motion and copy after reload
    intent: A real Lead reads the owned repository, attempts a benign missing read, renders grounded table/code and saved tool items, and preserves exact copy and history after reload.
    steps:
      - open: /ws/${AFT_WS}/agents
        intent: "Open the owned workspace's Agents page"
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).some(b => b.textContent.trim() === '+ Add agent')
        intent: "Wait for New Agent"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" motion-prime'
        intent: "Passively observe the future owned Chat EventSource before UI navigation, without sending an event"
      - click: { role: button, name: "+ Add agent", exact: true }
        intent: "Open the New Agent form"
      - click: { testid: create-agent-template-lead }
        intent: "Choose the Lead template"
      - fill: { testid: create-agent-name, value: "aft-${RUN_ID}-cov-visual-render" }
        intent: "Name this run's rendering Lead"
      - select: { testid: create-agent-backend, value: "${AFT_REAL_BACKEND}" }
        intent: "Select the real OpenCode backend"
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            (() => { const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=create-agent-repo-chips] button')];
              return r.length===1 && r[0].textContent.includes('source-repo') && r[0].getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true'; })()
        intent: "Confirm the owned Slack-clone repo is selected"
      - click: { testid: create-agent-submit }
        intent: "Create the Lead through the UI"
      - wait: { url: "/ws/${AFT_WS}/chat/agt_" }
        intent: "Wait for its real Chat route"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" claim render'
        intent: "Bind this journey to the actual saved Lead ID and repo"
      - run: '"$AFT_SELECT_AGENT_MODEL"'
        intent: "Select and read back the declared real model in the current Chat"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" motion-start'
        intent: "Arm bounded 100ms and rendered-frame observers before the real send"
      - fill:
          label: Message
          value: "VISUAL_RENDER_${RUN_ID}. Use your real file tools: read README.md, package.json, and BACKLOG.md, then attempt to read visual-missing-${RUN_ID}.txt; do not create it and let the missing-file error stand. From the three successful files, write between 650 and 750 words in six labeled sections of about 105 to 125 words each: setup, scripts, ticket routes, test coverage, missing-read result, and operational summary. Explain each of the six independent BACKLOG.md tickets using only the files read. Include a GFM table with a README.md row giving the test command and a package.json row giving its test script. Include a fenced json code block with the actual test script from package.json. Explain the missing read. Cite only facts from those reads. Before finishing, count your words and add source-grounded detail if fewer than 400. Do not edit files. End with the exact text VISUAL_END_${RUN_ID}."
        intent: "Ask for a long repository-grounded answer, real tool calls and a benign failed read"
      - press: Enter
        intent: "Send the request through Chat"
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            !!window.__aftChatVisualLive
        budget: 120000
        intent: "Wait for the pre-send DOM observer to capture an actual simultaneous running tool, Working row and Stop control"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" live-check && python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" shot render tool-transition'
        intent: "Read back the observed live state and capture its possibly completed transition; compare the later saved tool by time and file"
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-transcript] li[data-kind=agent] [data-streaming-caret]') &&
            !!document.querySelector('form button[title="Stop the running turn"]')
        budget: 180000
        intent: "Observe real streamed reply text and its active caret"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" shot render streaming'
        intent: "Capture the named streaming frame while the real turn is active"
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            (() => { const c=document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-transcript]');
              return c?.textContent.includes('VISUAL_END_${RUN_ID}') &&
                !document.querySelector('form button[title="Stop the running turn"]') &&
                !c.querySelector('[data-streaming-caret], [data-testid=working-row]'); })()
        budget: 180000
        intent: "Wait for the saved real turn to finish, flush text and remove caret and working row"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" shot render end && python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" motion-capture render'
        intent: "Freeze the first turn's final frame, saved events and caret state at the original checkpoint; motion validation remains pending"
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-transcript] [data-testid=chat-codeblock][data-language=json] code span')
        budget: 30000
        intent: "Wait for completed JSON code highlighting before reading its token spans"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" reasoning-capture before-reload'
        intent: "Freeze actual saved reasoning EventIDs and raw text, including null, with compact Thinking disclosures and an explicit nonexpandable empty-text explanation; available text expands exactly; original reasoning validation remains pending"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" render-check'
        intent: "Expand through UI clicks and compare table, highlighted code and all tool bodies with actual saved events"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" shot render expanded'
        intent: "Capture the expanded real tool input, output and failure"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" agent-hover'
        intent: "Require copy and time hidden at rest, visible on reply hover or keyboard focus, below the full reply and onscreen without shifting layout; capture both themes"
      - click: { selector: "[data-testid=chat-transcript] [data-testid=chat-codeblock][data-language=json] button[aria-label='Copy code']" }
        intent: "Copy the rendered code through its UI action"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" clipboard-check code'
        intent: "Read back the actual browser clipboard and Copied feedback for code"
      - click: { role: button, name: "Copy as Markdown", exact: true }
        intent: "Copy the rendered GFM table through its UI action"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" clipboard-check table'
        intent: "Read back the actual browser clipboard and Copied feedback for the table"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" copy-message'
        intent: "Copy the completed assistant message through its UI action"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" clipboard-check message'
        intent: "Compare clipboard bytes with the saved assistant message"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" snapshot render before-reload'
        intent: "Save exact event IDs before reload"
      - reload: true
        intent: "Reload the same Lead Chat"
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            (() => { const c=document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-transcript]');
              return c?.textContent.includes('VISUAL_END_${RUN_ID}') && !!c.querySelector('table') &&
                !!c.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-codeblock]'); })()
        intent: "Wait for persisted table, code and final answer"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" reasoning-capture reloaded'
        intent: "Freeze actual saved reasoning and collapsed/expanded Thinking DOM after reload without treating absent or null text as a pass"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" render-reload-check && python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" shot render reloaded'
        intent: "Compare exact saved event IDs and rendered tool/table/code after reload"
      - run: 'python3 "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/coverage-chat-visual.py" reasoning-presentation-grid'
        intent: "Check compact Thinking disclosures at 800 and 390px in both themes; expand saved text and close via keyboard, or show the nonexpandable empty-text explanation; keep the original reasoning-text requirement separate"

        intent: "Switch this owned browser session to reduced motion for a separate real turn"

          fn: >-
            matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
        intent: "Confirm the browser's reduced-motion preference is active"

            !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-transcript] li[data-kind=agent] [data-streaming-caret]') &&
            !!document.querySelector('form button[title="Stop the running turn"]')

        intent: "Observe an actual streaming answer under reduced motion"

        intent: "Require no fresh-word fade or caret/working animation in the real reduced-motion frame"
      - wait:

cases.name: a real backend follows the custom prompt and writes the instructed artifact
cases.intent: An operator defines a terminal teammate with inline instructions and the real backend carries them out at boot without any typed input
cases.evidence_class_required: external backend/model if official live/real launcher selected
cases.actor_policy: Preserve browser person actions, explicit public API client actions, agent-authored tool calls, and runtime stimulus as distinct actors; do not replace one with another.
cases.exact_original_case_source:
- name: a real backend follows the custom prompt and writes the instructed artifact
    intent: An operator defines a terminal teammate with inline instructions and the real backend carries them out at boot without any typed input
    steps:
      - run: |
          set -e
          run="${RUN_ID:-local}"
          ws_path="$(cat "$AFT_WORK_DIR/live-workspace.path")"
          # The prompt IS the fixture: the acceptance criterion is mechanically
          # checkable, and the marker token exists only in this prompt, so the
          # artifact proves three things at once — a real CLI ran (no stub writes
          # it), THIS run's prompt was delivered, and the custom prompt was used
          # rather than the built-in Lead persona.
          cat > "$AFT_WORK_DIR/li1.prompt" <<EOF
          Do this immediately, before saying anything, and without waiting for any further message.

          Create a file named MARKER-$run.md in your current working directory.
          Its entire contents must be exactly this one line:
          AFT-LIVE-$run

          Do not create, modify, or delete any other file. Do not run any git command.
          Once the file exists, reply with the single word DONE and stop. Do not ask any questions.
          EOF
          # Baseline the workspace root: it is NOT clean (the stack writes response
          # JSON after its seed commit), so "nothing else changed" has to be
          # measured against a snapshot, never against an empty git status.
          # Shared oracle (scripts/live-scope-baseline.sh): file digests + mode bits,
          # and per-repo refs/HEAD. Extracted so every live case measures scope the
          # same way instead of each carrying its own copy.
          "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/live-scope-baseline.sh" "$ws_path" "$AFT_WORK_DIR/li1-baseline.txt"
        intent: "An operator prepares the instructed-artifact prompt and snapshots the workspace baseline before any model runs"
      - open: /ws/E2E-WS-LIVE/agents
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            (() => {
              const page = document.querySelector('[data-testid=agents-page]');
              const add = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button'))
                .some((b) => (b.textContent || '').trim() === '+ Add agent');
              const agentCards = document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label^="Agent: "]');
              const settled = (location.pathname.split("/agents/")[1] || "").length > 0 || (add && agentCards.length === 0);
              const sig = [location.pathname, agentCards.length, add ? "add" : "no-add"].join("|");
              if (!page || !settled) {
                window.__aftAgentsPageStableSig = null;
                window.__aftAgentsPageStableAt = 0;
                return false;
              }
              if (window.__aftAgentsPageStableSig !== sig) {
                window.__aftAgentsPageStableSig = sig;
                window.__aftAgentsPageStableAt = Date.now();
                return false;
              }
              return Date.now() - window.__aftAgentsPageStableAt >= 300;
            })()
        intent: "Wait until the live workspace agents page is ready"
      - click: { role: button, name: "+ Add agent", exact: true }
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            (() => {
              const overlay = document.querySelector('[data-testid=create-agent-overlay]');
              if (overlay) {
                window.__aftCreateAgentOverlayWaitStartedAt = 0;
                return true;
              }
              if (!window.__aftCreateAgentOverlayWaitStartedAt) {
                window.__aftCreateAgentOverlayWaitStartedAt = Date.now();
              }
              const add = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button'))
                .some((b) => (b.textContent || '').trim() === '+ Add agent');
              if (Date.now() - window.__aftCreateAgentOverlayWaitStartedAt > 1000 && add && (location.pathname.endsWith("/agents") || location.pathname.includes("/agents/"))) {
                throw new Error('create-agent-overlay disappeared or never opened after + Add agent; agents page may have remounted during auto-select');
              }
              return false;
            })()
        intent: "Wait until the agent creation dialog is open"
      - click: { testid: create-agent-template-custom-prompt }
      - fill: { testid: create-agent-name, value: "live-cust-${RUN_ID:-local}" }
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=create-agent-backend] option').length > 1
        intent: "Wait until backend options load before selecting the live backend"
      - select: { testid: create-agent-backend, value: "${AFT_REAL_BACKEND:-codex}" }
      - run: >-
          agent-browser --session "$AFT_SESSION" find testid create-agent-interactive-prompt fill "$(cat "$AFT_WORK_DIR/li1.prompt")"
        intent: "An operator pastes the instructed-artifact prompt into the custom prompt field"
      - expect: { enabled: { testid: create-agent-submit, equals: true } }
      - click: { testid: create-agent-submit }
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            !document.querySelector('[data-testid=create-agent-overlay]') &&
            document.body.textContent.includes('live-cust-${RUN_ID:-local}')
        intent: "Wait until the live custom agent appears after submit"
      - open: /ws/E2E-WS-LIVE/agents/live-cust-${RUN_ID:-local}
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=terminal-wrapper] .wterm')
        intent: "Wait until the live agent terminal mounts its grid"
      # Readiness must be a signal ONLY the controlled runtime can produce. "Any
      # non-whitespace in the terminal" is not: `loom lead` prints its own
      # "Starting LEAD mode" banner before it ever invokes the backend
      # (cli/agent/lead/lead.go), so that assertion passed in 110ms on a run whose
      # app-server never came up. "Launching controlled ... lead session" is printed
      # only AFTER waitForCodexAppServer succeeds (leadcontrol/codex_runtime.go:163,
      # harness_runtime.go:115) — reaching it proves the runtime actually started.
      - wait:
          fn: >-
            (() => {
              const wrapper = document.querySelector('[data-testid=terminal-wrapper]');
              if (!wrapper) return false;
              const rows = Array.from(wrapper.querySelectorAll('.term-row')).map((el) => el.textContent || '').join('\n');
              if (rows.includes('Error running agent') || rows.includes('backend is not installed')) {
                throw new Error('lead runtime failed to start: ' + rows.slice(-400));
              }
              return /Launching controlled .*lead session/.test(rows);
            })()
        intent: "Wait until the controlled lead runtime reports it started, which only happens after the backend app-server is ready"
      - run: |
          set -e
          run="${RUN_ID:-local}"
          marker="$(cat "$AFT_WORK_DIR/live-workspace.path")/MARKER-$run.md"
          # budget: live-model (110s per window) - a real turn is slower than any
          # stub; each run: step is hard-capped at 120s, so the wait is chained.
          for i in $(seq 1 55); do
            [ -f "$marker" ] && exit 0
            sleep 2
          done
          echo "marker not written yet (grace window 1)"
          exit 0
        intent: "An operator waits a first bounded window for the real backend to produce the instructed artifact"
      - run: |
          set -e
          run="${RUN_ID:-local}"
          marker="$(cat "$AFT_WORK_DIR/live-workspace.path")/MARKER-$run.md"
          for i in $(seq 1 55); do
            [ -f "$marker" ] && exit 0
            sleep 2
          done
          echo "the real ${AFT_REAL_BACKEND:-codex} backend never produced $marker"
          exit 1
        intent: "An operator fails the run if the real backend never produced the instructed artifact"
      - run: |
          set -e
          run="${RUN_ID:-local}"
          ws_path="$(cat "$AFT_WORK_DIR/live-workspace.path")"
          # Clause 3 — the artifact's CONTENT is pinned, not merely its existence. The
          # earlier poll only proves the file exists; a model that wrote prose into it,
          # or appended chatter after the token, has not followed the instruction.
          #
          # Precisely: the token must be the entire content apart from AT MOST ONE
          # trailing newline. That is two accepted byte sequences, not one, so this is
          # not literally byte-exact — the tolerance is deliberate (a trailing newline
          # is near-universal model behaviour and not a instruction-following failure),
          # but nothing else is allowed: no prefix, no suffix, no second line.
          python3 - "$ws_path/MARKER-$run.md" "$run" <<'PY'
          import pathlib, sys
          got = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
          want = f"AFT-LIVE-{sys.argv[2]}".encode()
          assert got.rstrip(b"\n") == want, got[:200]
          assert got.count(b"\n") <= 1, got[:200]
          PY
          # Clause 5 — symmetric scope check: additions, modifications, deletions
          # and refs. The marker is the ONLY path this run is allowed to touch.
          "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/live-scope-verify.sh" "$ws_path" "$AFT_WORK_DIR/li1-baseline.txt" "MARKER-$run.md"
        intent: "An operator verifies the artifact contains exactly the run token (bar one optional trailing newline) and that the real backend changed nothing else"
      - run: |
          set -e
          name="live-cust-${RUN_ID:-local}"
          # budget: monitor-cache (20s) - the orchestration session must reach monitor status.
          for i in $(seq 1 20); do
            curl -sf "$AFT_BASE_URL/api/monitor/status?workspace=E2E-WS-LIVE" > "$AFT_WORK_DIR/li1-monitor.json" &&
            python3 - "$AFT_WORK_DIR/li1-monitor.json" "$name" <<'PY' && exit 0
          import json, sys
          d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
          name = sys.argv[2]
          matches = [a for a in d.get("agents", []) if a.get("name") == name]
          assert matches, d.get("agents")
          assert (matches[0].get("orchestrator_session_id") or "").startswith("lead-"), matches[0]
          PY
            sleep 1
          done
          echo "monitor never exposed an orchestration session for the live agent"
          cat "$AFT_WORK_DIR/li1-monitor.json" 2>/dev/null || true
          exit 1
        intent: "An operator confirms the live agent registered a real orchestration session"
      # Clause 1 (identity). An interactive lead records no task session, so the
      # transcript/diff evidence the worker cases use does not exist here — the
      # terminal tab is where identity is observable. Selecting one backend and
      # silently running another is exactly the confusion this tier exists to catch,
      # and without this the case would pass no matter which CLI answered.
      - run: |
          set -e
          run="${RUN_ID:-local}"
          name="live-cust-$run"
          backend="${AFT_REAL_BACKEND:-codex}"
          curl -sf "$AFT_BASE_URL/api/workspaces/E2E-WS-LIVE/terminal/tabs" > "$AFT_WORK_DIR/li1-tabs.json"
          python3 - "$AFT_WORK_DIR/li1-tabs.json" "$name" "$backend" <<'PY'
          import json, sys
          tabs = json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get("data") or []
          name, backend = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
          matches = [t for t in tabs if t.get("agent_id") == name]
          assert matches, tabs
          tab = matches[0]
          assert tab.get("backend") == backend, (tab.get("backend"), backend, tab)
          assert tab.get("role") == name, tab
          env = (tab.get("launch") or {}).get("env") or {}
          assert env.get("LOOM_AGENT_NAME") == name, env
          assert env.get("LOOM_AGENT_ROLE") == name, env
          assert env.get("LOOM_BACKEND") == backend, env
          PY
        intent: "An operator confirms the live terminal is attributed to this agent and the backend they selected"
      # Fatal, in-test cleanup: the PTY holds a billed process and suite teardown
      # is report-only in aft, so this must fail the test if it cannot close.
      - run: >-
          "$AFT_TESTS_DIR/scripts/live-close-agent-tab.sh" "live-cust-${RUN_ID:-local}" E2E-WS-LIVE
        intent: "An operator closes the live terminal and proves no paid process is left attached"

cases.exact_original_case_source:
- name: custom prompt reaches codex argv in the noninteractive runtime probe
    intent: A runtime contract probe confirms stored custom prompt text is passed to the backend as the final positional argument
    steps:
      - api:
          method: "POST"
          path: "/api/workspaces/E2E-WS-CUSTOM/agents"
          body:
            name: "cust-both-argv-${RUN_ID:-local}"
            role_name: "cust-both-argv-${RUN_ID:-local}"
            kind: "interactive"
            prompt: "AFT-INLINE-${RUN_ID:-local}"
            prompt_file: "builtin:pr-review"
            auto: false
            backend: "codex"
          status: 201
        intent: "An API client provisions the prompt precedence subject used by the same argv probe"
      - run: |
          set -e
          python3 - "$AFT_WORK_DIR" "$AFT_LOOM_BIN" "$AFT_LOOM_CONFIG_DIR" "${RUN_ID:-local}" <<'PY'
          import os, pathlib, shlex, stat, subprocess, sys
          work = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
          loom = sys.argv[2]
          config_dir = sys.argv[3]
          run = sys.argv[4]
          stub_dir = work / "cus-d14-stubbin"
          stub_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          stub = stub_dir / "codex"
          def write_stub(log):
              log_arg = shlex.quote(str(log))
              stub.write_text(f"""#!/bin/sh
          if [ "$1" = "--version" ]; then
            printf 'codex-cli 1.0.0\\n'
            exit 0
          fi
          printf '%s\\0' "$@" >> {log_arg}
          printf -- '--\\0' >> {log_arg}
          printf '{{"status":"completed","output":"stub"}}\\n'
          exit 0
          """, encoding="utf-8")
              stub.chmod(stub.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IXUSR | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH)

          def run_probe(agent, fixture=None, inline=None):
              log = work / f"{agent}.argv"
              out = work / f"{agent}.lead.out"
              if log.exists():
                  log.unlink()
              write_stub(log)
              env = os.environ.copy()
              env.update({
                  "PATH": str(stub_dir) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", ""),
                  "LOOM_CONFIG_DIR": config_dir,
                  "LOOM_LEAD_CONTROLLED": "0",
                  "LOOM_AGENT_NAME": agent,
                  "LOOM_AGENT_ROLE": agent,
              })
              env.pop("LOOM_AGENT_EFFORT", None)
              env.pop("LOOM_CLAUDE_EFFORT", None)
              with out.open("wb") as fh:
                  try:
                      subprocess.run([loom, "--workspace", "E2E-WS-CUSTOM", "--backend", "codex", "lead"], input=b"", stdout=fh, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env, timeout=60, check=True)
                  except Exception:
                      sys.stderr.write(out.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
                      if log.exists():
                          sys.stderr.write(repr(log.read_bytes()) + "\n")
                      raise
              raw = log.read_bytes()
              records = [r for r in raw.split(b"--\0") if r]
              assert records, raw
              exec_records = [
                  r for r in records
                  if ([x.decode("utf-8") for x in r.split(b"\0") if x] or [""])[0] == "exec"
              ]
              assert exec_records, raw
              first = [x.decode("utf-8") for x in exec_records[0].split(b"\0") if x]
              assert first[:3] == ["exec", "--json", "--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox"], first
              prompt = first[-1]
              if fixture:
                  want = pathlib.Path(fixture).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                  assert prompt.startswith(want), (prompt[:120], want)
                  assert "{{ .AgentName }}" in prompt, prompt
                  assert agent not in prompt, prompt
              if inline:
                  assert prompt.startswith(inline), prompt[:120]
                  assert "builtin:pr-review" not in prompt, prompt
              assert prompt.count("\n\n### Multi-Agent Safety Rules") == 1, prompt
              assert "## INTERACTIVE MODE: Project Lead" not in prompt, prompt
              for rec in exec_records[1:]:
                  assert rec == exec_records[0], raw

          run_probe(f"cust-tmpl-{run}", fixture=work / "cus-d5.prompt")
          run_probe(f"cust-both-argv-{run}", inline=f"AFT-INLINE-{run}")
          PY
        intent: "The local runtime probes codex argv with a per-test stub and verifies the custom prompt is final and literal"

- name: API accepts empty interactive prompts and the runtime falls back to the built-in lead prompt
    intent: An API client creates empty-prompt interactive agents and proves the backend prompt falls back to the built-in Lead persona
    steps:
      - api:
          method: "POST"
          path: "/api/workspaces/E2E-WS-CUSTOM-SURF/agents"
          body:
            name: "surf-empty-${RUN_ID:-local}"
            role_name: "surf-empty-${RUN_ID:-local}"
            kind: "interactive"
            prompt: ""
            auto: false
            backend: "claude"
          status: 201
        intent: "An API client creates an interactive agent with an empty inline prompt"
      - api:
          method: "POST"
          path: "/api/workspaces/E2E-WS-CUSTOM-SURF/agents"
          body:
            name: "surf-space-${RUN_ID:-local}"
            role_name: "surf-space-${RUN_ID:-local}"
            kind: "interactive"
            prompt: "   \n  "
            auto: false
            backend: "claude"
          status: 201
        intent: "An API client creates a second interactive agent whose whitespace prompt trims to empty"
      - run: |
          set -e
          run="${RUN_ID:-local}"
          for name in "surf-empty-$run" "surf-space-$run"; do
            LOOM_CONFIG_DIR="$AFT_LOOM_CONFIG_DIR" "$AFT_LOOM_BIN" --workspace E2E-WS-CUSTOM-SURF role show "$name" --json > "$AFT_WORK_DIR/s1-$name-role.json"
            code="$(curl -sS -o "$AFT_WORK_DIR/s1-$name-session.json" -w "%{http_code}" \
              -X POST "$AFT_BASE_URL/api/workspaces/E2E-WS-CUSTOM-SURF/agents/$name/terminal/session")"
            python3 - "$code" "$AFT_WORK_DIR/s1-$name-role.json" "$AFT_WORK_DIR/s1-$name-session.json" "$name" <<'PY'
          import json, sys
          code, role_path, session_path, name = sys.argv[1:5]
          role = json.load(open(role_path))
          assert role.get("kind") == "interactive", role
          assert role.get("prompt", "") == "", role
          assert role.get("prompt_file", "") == "", role
          body = json.load(open(session_path))
          assert code == "200", (code, body)
          tab = body.get("data") or {}
          assert tab.get("agent_id") == name, tab
          assert tab.get("backend") == "claude", tab
          cmd = ((tab.get("launch") or {}).get("argv") or ["", ""])[1]
          assert "'--backend' 'claude'" in cmd, cmd
          assert "--prompt" not in cmd, cmd
          PY
          done
        intent: "An API client reads each empty role and synchronous launch spec to verify no prompt_file flag is passed"
      - run: |
          set -e
          python3 - "$AFT_WORK_DIR" "$AFT_LOOM_BIN" "$AFT_LOOM_CONFIG_DIR" "${RUN_ID:-local}" <<'PY'
          import os, pathlib, shlex, stat, subprocess, sys
          work = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
          loom = sys.argv[2]
          config_dir = sys.argv[3]
          run = sys.argv[4]
          agent = f"surf-empty-{run}"
          log = work / "s1-codex.argv"
          stub_dir = work / "s1-stubbin"
          stub_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          stub = stub_dir / "codex"
          log_arg = shlex.quote(str(log))
          stub.write_text(f"""#!/bin/sh
          if [ "$1" = "--version" ]; then
            printf 'codex-cli 1.0.0\\n'
            exit 0
          fi
          printf '%s\\0' "$@" >> {log_arg}
          printf -- '--\\0' >> {log_arg}
          printf '{{"status":"completed","output":"stub"}}\\n'
          exit 0
          """, encoding="utf-8")
          stub.chmod(stub.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IXUSR | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH)
          out = work / "s1-lead.out"
          if log.exists():
              log.unlink()
          env = os.environ.copy()
          env.update({
              "PATH": str(stub_dir) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", ""),
              "LOOM_CONFIG_DIR": config_dir,
              "LOOM_LEAD_CONTROLLED": "0",
              "LOOM_AGENT_NAME": agent,
              "LOOM_AGENT_ROLE": agent,
          })
          env.pop("LOOM_AGENT_EFFORT", None)
          env.pop("LOOM_CLAUDE_EFFORT", None)
          with out.open("wb") as fh:
              try:
                  subprocess.run([loom, "--workspace", "E2E-WS-CUSTOM-SURF", "--backend", "codex", "lead"], input=b"", stdout=fh, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env, timeout=60, check=True)
              except Exception:
                  sys.stderr.write(out.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
                  if log.exists():
                      sys.stderr.write(repr(log.read_bytes()) + "\n")
                  raise
          raw = log.read_bytes()
          records = [r for r in raw.split(b"--\0") if r]
          assert records, raw
          exec_records = [
              r for r in records
              if ([x.decode("utf-8") for x in r.split(b"\0") if x] or [""])[0] == "exec"
          ]
          assert exec_records, raw
          argv = [x.decode("utf-8") for x in exec_records[0].split(b"\0") if x]
          assert argv[:3] == ["exec", "--json", "--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox"], argv
          prompt = argv[-1]
          assert prompt.startswith("## INTERACTIVE MODE: Project Lead"), prompt[:160]
          assert prompt.count("\n\n### Multi-Agent Safety Rules") == 1, prompt
          for rec in exec_records[1:]:
              assert rec == exec_records[0], raw
          PY
        intent: "The local runtime probes codex argv with a per-test stub and proves the empty custom role falls back to the built-in Lead prompt"
